people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Simon
people.line: A man in Bethany who hosted Jesus for a meal.

translations.web: Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.” He said, “Teacher, say on.”
translations.bsb: But Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.” “Tell me, Teacher,” he said.
translations.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Master, say on.
translations.asv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Teacher, say on.
